wireguard.agent.allowed-networks-hint: Comma-separated CIDRs this agent may reach via the hub. Empty = full mesh (all other sites). Enforced only on this agent's own gateway, not at the hub: not a security boundary.
wireguard.agent.create-failed: The agent could not be created: {error}
wireguard.agent.delete-confirm: Delete agent {name}? Its token is revoked at once and the gateway is no longer managed from here. If its Freigaben filter is restricted, switch it to open first.
wireguard.agent.delete-force-confirm: {name} cannot be deleted normally: its Freigaben filter is not confirmed as open, and the agent has not reported for over an hour. Delete it anyway? The gateway then keeps its last Freigaben filter (chain FG_IN) until it is removed there by hand.
wireguard.agent.hub-url-hint: Primary / fallback URL all agents use to reach the hub. Pushed to every agent on its next poll — change it here when the hub domain moves.
wireguard.agent.hub-url-invalid: Must be a valid http(s) URL
wireguard.agent.ingress.applied.failed: The agent did NOT apply the ruleset — the filter is not active as shown.
wireguard.agent.ingress.applied.offline: The agent has not reported for more than 5 minutes (offline) — the current ruleset will only be applied once it is back.
wireguard.agent.ingress.applied.pending: The agent has not confirmed the current ruleset yet (applies on its next poll).
wireguard.agent.ingress.applied.unknown: The agent reports no filter status (agent script too old or offline) — whether the filter is active is unknown.
wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.explain: The ingress filter checks traffic that wants to enter this site’s network from the tunnel.
wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.open: All traffic from the tunnel gets through.
wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.open-exce: Ingress filter off – traffic from other sites gets through, except from: {sites} (separated on the hub).
wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.restricte: Only released traffic from the tunnel reaches this network ({count, plural, one {# active rule} other {# active rules}}).
Ingress filter on, but no active rule – all traffic from the tunnel is dropped.
wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.title-off: Ingress filter at this site: off
wireguard.agent.ingress.banner.title-on: Ingress filter at this site: on
wireguard.agent.ingress.catalog.hub-snat: Also carries every hub-LAN host (SNAT to the hub address)
wireguard.agent.ingress.catalog.masquera: This site hides its LAN addresses (masquerade): its traffic arrives with the tunnel address
wireguard.agent.ingress.catalog.unavaila: Names and assistants are unavailable (catalog could not be loaded) — rules can still be entered as IP/CIDR.
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.broad: Hub rules broader than the proxy traffic needs — the hub address also carries every Hetzner-LAN host (SNAT), so these let Mailcow, the web server CT etc. in as well:
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.broad.all-: no port list: every port of the targets is open — limit it to the upstream port(s)
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.egress-not: Hub-originated traffic via the SNAT/tunnel address (e.g. Mailcow → DC) uses no proxy host — it is only checked when listed in /data/hub-egress-flows.json ({count} listed).
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.lead: Compares the proxy hosts and streams on the hub with the rules of this site.
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.link-clien: The bound WireGuard link "{link}" exists but is typed "client", so it is not checked as a site. Set its type to site-to-site if it is a site gateway.
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.link-missi: The bound WireGuard link "{link}" was not found — nothing checked. Re-bind the agent to a link.
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.missing-di: Disabled proxy hosts/streams without a rule (no traffic now, 504 at the hub once enabled):
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.missing-op: Not covered by a rule (informational while the filter is off — with the filter on these targets would be dropped):
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.missing-re: The agent currently drops these proxy host / stream targets (504 at the hub):
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.no-port: port unknown — create the rule by hand with the port(s) used
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.none: No check data for this agent.
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.title: Proxy cross-check
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.unchecked: Not checkable — the upstream is a host name that does not resolve:
wireguard.agent.ingress.check.unused: no proxy host/stream uses this target (maybe manual configuration)
wireguard.agent.ingress.col.name: Name
wireguard.agent.ingress.comfort.missing-: Create {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} for the missing proxy targets?
wireguard.agent.ingress.comfort.prune-co: Switch off {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} without a new connection for 30 days?
wireguard.agent.ingress.comfort.prune-do: Switched off {count, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}}.
wireguard.agent.ingress.comfort.prune-hi: Hits only count NEW connections: long-lived sessions (LDAP, IMAP, iSCSI) look idle. Switched-off rules can be switched on again at any time.
wireguard.agent.ingress.confirm-open: Turn the ingress filter off? All traffic from the tunnel then reaches this network unfiltered — the rules only count hits. A separation between sites on the hub stays in place.
wireguard.agent.ingress.confirm-restrict: Turn the ingress filter on? All traffic forwarded from the tunnel into the LAN that does not match an active rule will be dropped — a missing rule cuts the site off for that traffic. Services on the gateway itself are not filtered.
wireguard.agent.ingress.danger.orphan: The WireGuard connection of this agent no longer exists – it can only be removed here.
wireguard.agent.ingress.danger.text: Revokes this site's agent: its token stops working at once and the gateway is no longer managed from here. Meant for sites that no longer exist.
wireguard.agent.ingress.danger.title: Remove agent
wireguard.agent.ingress.empty.text: A rule lets a source – the reverse proxy on the hub, another site or VPN clients – reach specific targets and ports in this network. While the filter is off, rules only count hits.
wireguard.agent.ingress.empty.text-restr: The filter is on – without a rule nothing gets through right now. Create the first rule.
wireguard.agent.ingress.empty.title: No rules yet

wireguard.agent.ingress.field.sources-hi: IPv4 addresses or CIDRs, comma or newline separated (at least one).
wireguard.agent.ingress.form.broad: This rule opens every port or the whole site — check that this is intended.
wireguard.agent.ingress.hit.stale: no new connection for more than 30 days — long-lived connections (e.g. LDAP, IMAP) are not counted, check before deleting

wireguard.agent.ingress.sites.matrix-cap: Which sites are separated from each other (each pair once)
wireguard.agent.ingress.sites.summary: {blocked, plural, =0 {{total, plural, one {The site pair is not separated} other {None of the # site pairs separated}}} other {# of {total} site pairs separated}}

wireguard.agent.ingress.sites.title: Separation between sites (on the hub)
wireguard.agent.ingress.sites.too-few: There are fewer than two site-to-site links – nothing to separate.

wireguard.agent.ingress.sites.warning.li: A stored separation refers to a link that no longer exists – it is skipped and removed on the next save.
